I'll search for that.

What they're getting:

- Loomly: $18,400, Pinecrest Rentals: $6,200 — $24,600 total [4]. That's 100% of each one's November platform fees, applied as credit memos on their December invoices, no cash [4][8]. It started as a 50% proposal (~$9.2k / ~$3.1k) but Rachel said 50% wouldn't fly with Loomly, since 1,312 of the 1,840 late payouts were theirs and some sellers ate overdraft fees [4].
- Separately, Loomly asked for reimbursement of overdraft fees for 214 sellers, $7,690 [5]. That one is not decided and not accrued — Marcus is flagging it as an open item in the close memo, with an answer promised to Loomly by Nov 25 [1][5].

On the November books: yes, the $24,600 is meant to be accrued in the November close as a reduction of revenue (contra-revenue), to be reversed when the credit memos are issued on the December invoices [1]. Marcus said he'd accrue it in the November close [4], and the close checklist has "Service credits accrual – payout incident (Loomly, Pinecrest)" assigned to Marcus as in progress [7]. Note the close locks Dec 7, so as of the latest trace it was in progress, not done [1][7].
